gloss: to return; to come back; to be reinstated

definitions.gloss: to return; to come back; to be reinstated
definitions.explanation: To return to a previous position, role, or state after a period of absence. Commonly used for returning to work after leave, an athlete coming back from injury, or territory being returned to a nation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{復帰|ふっき}する。
examples.english: To return to the workplace after parental leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{復帰|ふっき}した⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The player who came back from injury scored a goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、ようやく⟦{社会|しゃかい}{復帰|ふっき}→社会復帰：20417_shakaifukki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: After a long hospital stay, he finally achieved his return to society.

notes:
Implies returning to a role or status that one previously held, after an interruption. Carries a sense of formal reinstatement rather than casual return.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧: return to the workplace
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}{復帰|ふっき}→社会復帰：20417_shakaifukki⟧: return to society (after illness, incarceration, etc.)
- ⟦{現役|げんえき}→現役：21782_geneki⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧: return to active duty/service
- ⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧: comeback match
- ⟦{本土|ほんど}→本土：05500_hondo⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧: reversion to the mainland

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧ (the reversion of Okinawa) in 1972 is often referred to as ⟦{本土|ほんど}→本土：05500_hondo⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧, marking the return of Okinawa to Japanese sovereignty from American administration.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return, to go back — more general and everyday, while ⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧ implies formal reinstatement to a previous role or status
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧: to recover — focuses on regaining health or a previous condition, while ⟦{復帰|ふっき}→復帰：12564_fukki⟧ focuses on returning to a position or role
